redwood reserve capacity create --pool la-dedicated --gpus 8 --until 2026-06-30 --owner ajay
```
leah: I need the exact PDUs and RU numbers before I can schedule racking. @maria can you attach the manifest here? :eyes:

leah: On-site racking slot requested: Wed 2026-04-24 09:00-13:00. Inviting infra/security.
maria: Next async check-in Friday 14:00 PT. If anything urgent in the meantime, ping this thread or DM. :thumbsup:
